sources.snippet: Note: FLUX.2 has a different block structure (Klein: 5 double / 20 single vs FLUX.1's 19/38), shared modulation, hidden dim 3072 (Klein 4B) vs 4096 (FLUX.1), and Qwen3 text encoder (vs T5) — so the injection system was rebuilt from scratch.
